text:
maria: Heads up — need 4x A100-standard slots in uk-west for an overnight demo (22:00-02:00 UTC). Anyone have standby capacity or a quick quota swap with vendor? Pref dedicated burst, short window only.
kevin: We have 2 free A100s in demo-standby but quotas are bound to project `redwood-demo`. Could borrow from analytics for a few hours? @ashley will need to approve.
ashley: I can approve if it's <=4 hours. Is this perf-sensitive? If so please avoid spot instances.
devon: Perf-sensitive — low latency interactive demo. Recommend dedicated burst. @maria which model + seq len?
maria: Small Llama-ish model for interactive UI, seq ~1024, expect ~120 TPS at concurrency 3. Not a heavy batch run.
kevin: Ok, sounds fine. I'll open a quick quota-swap with vendor-ops and ping procurement. Creating PR: `terraform: swap-demo-project-alloc.tf` — can someone do a fast CR?
ashley: Reviewing now. One nit on labels: use `team=demo` and add `ttl_hours=4`.
vendor-ops-bot: vendor-ops: Received quota-swap request #4582 from kevin. ETA provisioning ~30-45m. Contact: luke@vendorcloud.com.
maria: Perfect. @kevin please ensure we have a canary fallback to eu-west in case uk-west provisioning stalls.
kevin: Added fallback route and a canary: ```route: uk-west -> eu-west; fallback_model: small-llama-quant; canary_percent: 5``` Will also set autoscale min=0 max=4 for the burst.
devon: Adding a KV-cache prewarm step to the deploy script to avoid first-token latency spike. Will push a small hook to the PR.
ashley: Approved the quota-swap and tags. :thumbsup:
kevin: Vendor confirmed slots provisioned, moving workloads now and merging PR after devon pushes prewarm.
maria: Thanks all — I'll run smoke tests and post the demo link in #eng-demo once green. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :raised_hands:
kevin: Cool — ping if you see any eviction/soft-errors, I'll have vendor on standby.
devon: Quick note for postmortem: add a metric for `burst-takeover-latency` so we can quantify handoff delays next time.
maria: noted, will add to the retro. Thanks!
